title: Kinder- en Jeugdpsychiater gebiedsteam Amsterdam Zuidoost
description:
*Ben jij de kinder- en jeugdpsychiater bij wie collega's aankloppen zodra het ingewikkeld wordt, en denk je graag mee over diagnostiek, behandeling en beleid? Kom samen bouwen aan jeugdhulp die werkt!*
**Jouw functie, jouw team**
Kinderen en jongeren met complexe psychiatrische problematiek hebben jou nodig. Als kinder- en jeugdpsychiater bij Levvel combineer je medische expertise met een brede, systemische blik. Je werkt nauw samen met gezinnen en multidisciplinaire teams en samen kom je tot oplossingen die écht werken. Zo lever je een directe bijdrage aan veilige, effectieve en samenhangende zorg voor kinderen, jongeren en hun omgeving.
  
  
Jouw kennis wordt ingezet voor consultaties bij de meest complexe vraagstukken. We zijn een erkende opleidingsplek voor verschillende hbo-functies, P-opleidingen en de opleiding tot kinder- en jeugdpsychiater. Wat ons bijzonder maakt, is dat we onderzoek en innovatie aan elkaar koppelen. Zo vinden we nieuwe oplossingen voor moeilijke problemen. Levvel heeft drie afdelingen met het TOP GGZ-keurmerk: het Expertisecentrum voor Dwang, Angst en Tics (DAT), het Centrum voor Trauma en Gezin, en de afdeling Complexe Gedragsstoornissen en Forensische Jeugdpsychiatrie. Daarnaast zijn er teams die begeleiding en behandeling bieden bij veelvoorkomende én zeldzame klachten. Samen zorgen we dat kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen weer verder komen.
  
  
Je werkt binnen het gebiedsteam dichtbij de kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen die jouw hulp nodig hebben. Je werkt in het team samen met basis- tot specialistische- psychologen en orthopedagogen, gedragswetenschappers, systeemtherapeuten en specialistisch ambulant hulpverleners, vaak een AIOS en onder leiding van een teamleider. Samen brengen we (hoog)specialistische jeugdhulp nabij en zo thuis mogelijk.
  
  
Fijn als jij erbij komt voor 24 tot 36 uur per week!
  
  
*Nieuwsgierig naar hoe de werkplek eruit ziet bekijk dit filmpje:*
*https://www.levvel.nl/locaties/bijlmerdreef*
**Jouw werkzaamheden**

* Je voert diagnostiek en behandeling uit. Je brengt diagnoses en indicaties in kaart en neemt de regie over behandeltrajecten binnen een multidisciplinair team. Samen met het kind, het gezin en betrokken professionals stel je een behandelplan op en je zorgt dat dit ook uitgevoerd wordt. Je voert specialistische behandelingen uit, waaronder psychofarmacologische interventies, en stuurt bij waar nodig. Zo krijgt ieder kind en gezin de best mogelijke zorg.
* Je geeft regie, biedt consultatie en werkt samen. Je geeft richting aan het behandelproces en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor collega's. Bij complexe casuïstiek vragen ze regelmatig jouw advies. Met ketenpartners zoals huisartsen, ziekenhuizen en jeugdzorgorganisaties zorg je dat de zorg goed op elkaar aansluit. In multidisciplinaire overleggen draag je bij aan belangrijke beslissingen en vertegenwoordig je de medische expertise, intern én extern.
* Je ontwikkelt beleid en deelt je kennis. Naast je werk in de directe patiëntenzorg draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de jeugdpsychiatrische zorg. Je denkt mee over beleid en brengt dit in de praktijk. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de zorg, vertaalt nieuwe inzichten naar de dagelijkse praktijk en stimuleert de professionele ontwikkeling van collega's. Waar mogelijk lever je een bijdrage aan innovatie, onderzoek en de doorontwikkeling van behandelmethodieken.
* Je geeft richting en stimuleert ontwikkeling. Je begeleidt en geeft supervisie aan artsen (ANIOS/AIOS) en andere behandelaren. Je neemt deel aan commissies, projectgroepen en vakinhoudelijke overleggen.
* Je blijft groeien voor jezelf én voor de ander. Je volgt ontwikkelingen in het vakgebied en levert een bijdrage aan wetenschappelijk onderzoek en innovatie binnen de kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie. In overleggen en teammomenten denk je mee en draag je bij aan de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Je werkt samen met partners binnen én buiten de organisatie en bouwt actief aan je netwerk. En je reflecteert op je eigen handelen en staat open voor feedback zo blijf je scherp en professioneel.

**Over jou**
**Diploma en registraties:**
Je hebt een BIG registratie als Kinder- en Jeugdpsychiater.
  
  
**Kennis en ervaring**
: Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met ontwikkelingspsychologie, diagnostische vaardigheden en crisisinterventie.
  
  
**Beschikbaarheid:**
Je bent in ieder geval beschikbaar op de donderdag en bereid om bereikbaarheidsdiensten te draaien. Werken in meerdere gebiedsteams behoort tot de mogelijkheden.
  
  
**Skills:**
Je hebt een verbindende werkhouding en kunt regie voeren. Daarnaast heb je vakinhoudelijke expertise met oog voor een breder perspectief en ben jij een echte teamspeler die waar nodig outreachend te werk gaat.
  
  
**Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden**
**Een goed begin**
: Je start met een jaarcontract, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  
  
**Salaris**
: Volgens de CAO GGZ Medisch Specialisten € 6.691 - € 11.292 (op basis van 36 uur).
  
  
**Extra’s die het verschil maken**
: Van een fietsregeling en collectieve zorgverzekering tot een thuiswerkvergoeding van €3,05 per dag.
  
  
**Toeslagen:**
Een ruime vergoeding voor bereikbaarheidsdiensten.
  
  
**Ruimte om te groeien**
: Met
*Het Goede Gesprek*
jaarlijks over jouw ontwikkeling en toegang tot het platform LEO voor trainingen en opleidingen.
  
  
**Werkplezier:**
Want naast het werk is er ruimte voor ontspanning: van sportactiviteiten tot gezellige personeelsfeesten.
  
  
**Benieuwd wat Levvel nog meer te bieden heeft?**
**Bekijk hier ons aanbod**
**Solliciteren?**
De vacature staat open tot we deze vervuld hebben. We plannen bij een match zo snel mogelijk een gesprek, wacht dus niet met solliciteren.
  
  
Inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Bojoura Maarbach beantwoordt ze graag: 06 24 19 31 28.
  
  
Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Mail dan met werving en selectie: werk@levvel.nl. Jamie Chapman is contactpersoon van deze vacature.

title: Income Maintenance Caseworker I- Family and Children's Medicaid
description:

**General Definition Of Work**
This position will be assigned to administer the application process and determine eligibility for Family & Children’s Medicaid and sub-programs. This caseworker will be one of two primary intake caseworkers responsible for taking applications from 8:00AM–5:00PM daily as scheduled on the intake calendar. Applications received by methods other than in-person will be assigned on a rotating basis. Responsibilities include interviewing clients to obtain required information, entering the applications in the North Carolina Families Accessing Services through Technology (NC FAST) system, verifying the information obtained, and determining ongoing eligibility for each application taken. This position will be required to interview applicants on a daily basis.
  
  
Participation in Shelter Management is required in the event of emergencies or disasters. This service, if required, will take precedence over duties described in this position vacancy announcement. This position is required to perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor and could be subject to overtime which is given in the form of compensatory time.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
Good mathematical reasoning and computational skills. Ability to communicate with clients, applicants, and the public to obtain data, and to explain and interpret rules, policies, and procedures. Ability to understand the needs and problems of clients/applicants. Ability to learn the program area of assignment and all agency programs and services which could affect the client/applicant.
  
  
**Education And Experience**
Graduation from an accredited associate degree program in Human Services Technology, Social Services Associate, Paralegal Technology, Business Administration, Secretarial Science, or a closely related curriculum; or graduation from high school and two years of paraprofessional, clerical, or other public contact experience which included negotiating, interviewing, explaining information, gathering and compiling of data, analysis of data and/or performance of mathematical or legal tasks with at least one year of such experience being in an income maintenance program; or graduation from high school and three years of paraprofessional, clerical or other public contact experience which included negotiating, interviewing, explaining information, the gathering and compiling of data, the analysis of data and/or the performance of mathematical or legal tasks; or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

**About The University**
Swansea University is a research-led university that has been making a difference since 1920. The University community thrives on exploration and discovery and offers the right balance of excellent teaching and research, matched by an enviable quality of life.
  
  
Our stunning waterfront campuses and multicultural community make us a desirable workplace for colleagues from around the world. Our reward and benefits, and ways of working enable those who join us to have enriching careers, matched by an excellent work-life balance.
  
  
**About The Role**
The PDRA will join the research programme led by Prof. M. Piai, applying lattice field theory techniques and numerical implementations to new strongly coupled realizations of composite dynamics and its applications, with particular reference to the TELOS collaboration. Specific scientific goals will be codesigned, and involve a combination of software development, testing and benchmarking on high performance computing facilities, as well as on physics analysis pertinent to one or more of the physics aims and objectives of the collaboration.
  
  
The ideal candidate for the post has a strong background in programming and running lattice calculations on modern, parallel computing facilities, using both CPU and GPU architecture, as well as previous experience with theoretical particle physics. Familiarity with current trends in extensions of the Standard Model is desirable, as is expertise with effective field theory techniques, and with more formal theoretical ideas, such as those of gauge/gravity dualities. The project will include both a software development component and a physics analysis one, hence candidates are invited to provide in their application technical details about their previous experience on both aspects.
  
  
The candidate is expected to take active part in the TELOS collaboration, committing to its the research aims and objectives, professional values, and code of conduct, including its open access, open data and open software policies. They will have the opportunity to co-supervise the research aspects of the activity of postgraduate research students. They will participate to the activities of the Centre for Quantum Fields and Gravity, including attending and organising seminars in the broad context of theoretical particle physics.
  
  
The appointment is for 1 year full-time, but can be converted into a part-time appointment (50%) for two years. Extension to a third year might become possible in principle, if additional funding becomes available, and pending performance review.

**Company Description**
Happys Car World is a retail automotive dealership focused on helping customers find vehicles that fit their needs and budget. The company offers a range of cars and related products, aiming to provide a straightforward, friendly buying experience. Team members work in a dynamic showroom environment where customer satisfaction and honest guidance are core priorities. Happys Car World values reliable, service-oriented staff who can support a positive reputation in the local community.

* Product Knowledge related to vehicles, features, and financing options, or the ability to learn quickly.
* Basic math and computer skills for handling pricing, documentation, and sales systems.
* Previous experience in retail, automotive sales, or a customer-facing role is preferred but not mandatory.
* Ability to work on-site in Bally, including weekends and peak business hours as needed.
* Self-motivated attitude, professional appearance, and willingness to follow ethical sales practices.

description:
On our Geoscience and Petrotechnical teams, proven expertise and intelligent tech meet, powering our legacy and future of subsurface solutions. Whether in the field or our learning centers, your unique skills and understanding of hydrocarbons will help solve the toughest challenges for clients every day. And with a start at SLB, you’ll be set up for a bright future making a real impact across our business and industry.
  
  
As a
**Geologist**
, you will combine your understanding of earth sciences with a comprehensive knowledge of the latest logging technologies to determine reservoir architecture and hydrocarbon potential. You will become adept at multiple software systems and work closely with customers to find innovative ways to solve some of their most complex challenges.
  
  
As one of our
**Geophysicists**
, you will apply your knowledge and expertise of the earth’s properties to enhance interpretations of geological data and greater define how we understand the subsurface. We acquire huge amounts of often previously unseen seismic and geophysical data around the world and you will help transform it into the knowledge that powers better decision-making and more effective, more efficient services. You will be involved in the acquisition, processing and interpretation of that data and we offer a range of career opportunities to develop your skills and get exposure across the data lifecycle.
  
  
As a
**Petrophysicist**
, you will combine logging data from multiple downhole sensors with sample data to determine hydrocarbon production capacity, lithology and fluid saturation of the reservoir to ultimately help us optimize its production. You will incorporate data from multiple wells and additional sensors to consider acoustics, spectroscopy and magnetic resonance to enhance overall accuracy or build a clearer picture of the reservoir by understanding its permeability and mechanical properties.
  
  
As a
**Reservoir Engineer**
, you will use data and our leading software products and solutions to create reservoir models that help clients make decisions that deliver safer, optimized, long-term production for each reservoir by simulating fluid flow phase behavior and reservoir physical properties.
  
  
As a
**Production Optimization Engineer**
, you will deliver performance improvements to our clients’ assets worldwide though virtual representations of our downhole products which incorporate calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), computation fluid dynamics (CFD), costing and parametric modeling into one cohesive system.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
**LAZ Airport Services | Administrative Support | Full-Time | Non-Exempt**
****Organize the Details. Support the Team. Keep the Operation Moving.****
At LAZ Airport Services, successful airport operations depend on strong organization, clear communication, accurate information, and consistent follow-through. The Administrative Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative support to the General Manager and helps ensure that important details, deadlines, meetings, documents, and requests are managed effectively.
  
  
This position serves as a trusted administrative resource for the General Manager and airport leadership team. From coordinating calendars and preparing reports to maintaining records and supporting employee activities, the Administrative Coordinator helps leaders stay organized, informed, and prepared.
  
  
The work is varied, and priorities may shift throughout the day. One moment may involve preparing materials for an upcoming meeting, while the next may require gathering information, updating a tracker, coordinating with another LAZ department, or assisting with an unexpected operational need.
  
  
The right person is organized, responsive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of administrative assignments. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys supporting others, solving problems, and helping a busy airport operation run more efficiently.
  
  
**Why Join LAZ?**

* Serve as a trusted administrative partner to the General Manager and airport leadership team.
* Work in a dynamic airport environment where your support directly contributes to operational success.
* Gain exposure to multiple areas of airport operations and business administration.
* Build relationships with leaders, employees, clients, and LAZ support departments.
* Develop new administrative, technical, and operational skills.
* Access career growth and advancement opportunities.
* Participate in employee recognition and development programs.
* Access PayActiv, the Employee Assistance Program, and health coaching and wellness resources.

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Short-Term Disability Coverage
* Long-Term Disability Coverage
* Life Insurance Options

**About LAZ Airport Services**
LAZ Airport Services supports parking, transportation, and related operations that help travelers move safely and efficiently through the airport environment. Our teams work behind the scenes and on the front lines to support employees, customers, clients, and the overall travel experience.
  
  
The Administrative Coordinator contributes to that mission by ensuring the General Manager and airport leadership team have the organization, information, communication, and administrative support needed to lead the operation effectively.
  
  
**Parking is our industry, but people are our passion.**
**Schedule & Work Environment**
The Administrative Coordinator primarily works in an office environment located within or near an active airport operation. The position regularly interacts with operational leaders, employees, clients, visitors, and internal LAZ support departments.
  
  
The role requires regular computer and telephone use, frequent communication, and the ability to manage multiple requests and interruptions. The Administrative Coordinator may occasionally move throughout airport offices and operational areas to support meetings, activities, or business needs.
  
  
Airport operations can change quickly. The position requires flexibility and responsiveness during peak periods, special events, operational changes, or other situations requiring additional administrative support.
  
  
**The Spirit of the Position**
The Administrative Coordinator is the General Manager’s administrative right hand. The GM is responsible for a busy airport operation with employees, clients, meetings, deadlines, documentation, and operational priorities all competing for attention. Your role is to bring organization, consistency, and follow-through to those moving pieces.
  
  
You help the General Manager stay prepared and focused by managing administrative details before they become distractions. You maintain schedules, prepare documents, organize information, track follow-up items, and help make sure important responsibilities do not fall through the cracks.
  
  
This position requires initiative. You will not always receive detailed instructions for every assignment. You should be comfortable asking thoughtful questions, gathering information, identifying the appropriate resources, and determining the next reasonable step.
  
  
You also handle information that may be sensitive or confidential. The General Manager and leadership team must be able to rely on your professionalism, judgment, discretion, and commitment to accuracy.
  
  
Most importantly, you understand that excellent administrative support is about helping people succeed. Your organization and follow-through allow leaders to focus on employees, customers, clients, safety, and the overall success of the airport operation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**General Manager Support**

* Provide comprehensive day-to-day administrative support to the General Manager.
* Coordinate the General Manager’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
* Help organize administrative requests, deadlines, commitments, and follow-up items.
* Prepare agendas, meeting materials, presentations, correspondence, and other documents.
* Take meeting notes and maintain follow-up lists when requested.
* Assist the General Manager with special projects and changing administrative priorities.
* Anticipate routine administrative needs and identify items requiring attention or follow-up.
* Protect the General Manager’s time by helping organize requests and directing routine matters appropriately.

**Communication & Coordination**

* Serve as an administrative point of coordination between the General Manager, airport leadership, employees, clients, visitors, and LAZ support departments.
* Draft, format, proofread, and distribute professional correspondence and employee communications.
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, leadership visits, presentations, and other business activities.
* Gather information from appropriate stakeholders and organize it for leadership review.
* Track requests and follow up with responsible individuals to support timely completion.
* Respond to routine administrative questions and direct more complex matters to the appropriate leader or department.
* Maintain professional and responsive communication across all levels of the operation.

2. Fabric & Accessories Inspection

* Verify labels, tags, buttons, zippers, prints, embroidery, and other garment components against approved specifications.
* Report defective materials and coordinate with the concerned departments for corrective action.

3. Measurement & Technical Quality

* Conduct garment measurement checks according to approved size specifications and measurement charts.
* Verify tolerances and ensure compliance with buyer-specific quality requirements.
* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure adherence to approved samples, construction details, and workmanship standards.

4. Production Quality Monitoring

* Monitor production processes to identify and prevent quality issues at an early stage.
* Coordinate with production supervisors, line in-charges, and stitching operators to resolve defects.
* Conduct re-inspections after corrective actions have been implemented.
* Ensure rejected or defective garments are segregated and properly identified.
* Support the production team in reducing rejection rates, rework, and material wastage.

5. Final Inspection & Packing

* Conduct final inspection of finished garments before dispatch or shipment.
* Check garment appearance, measurements, labeling, folding, packing, and carton details.
* Verify packing instructions and buyer-specific requirements.
* Ensure the required quality checks are completed before goods are approved for dispatch.
* Assist during buyer inspections and third-party quality inspections, as required.

6. Quality Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain inspection reports, defect records, measurement reports, and rejection data.
* Prepare daily quality reports and communicate major quality issues to the reporting manager.
* Track defect rates and identify recurring problems.
* Maintain records of corrective actions and follow up to ensure implementation.
* Support quality audits and maintain relevant inspection documentation.

7. Compliance & Quality Standards

* Ensure compliance with company quality procedures and applicable buyer quality standards.

Performs unskilled and skilled work in the operation and maintenance of streets, bridges, parks, natural areas and recreation areas to maintain a beautiful, safe and welcoming environment for the community of Trinidad and its visitors.

The mission of every employee at the City of Trinidad is to deliver exceptional value and quality of life to all our citizens. Each employee is measured by the ability to adhere to the city’s core value of Pride which is delivered through Purpose, Responsibility, Integrity, Dependability and Excellence. As a City, we embrace and celebrate diversity and equity for all citizens and recognize that it is a privilege to serve the citizens of Trinidad, Colorado.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
*The following statements are illustrative of the essential functions of the job and do not include other nonessential or peripheral duties that may be required. The City of Trinidad retains the right to modify or change the essential duties and additional functions of the job at any time without notice. Examples of duties are not intended to be all-inclusive or restrictive. Responsibilities as outlined in the City Charter:*
**Note**
:
**Regular and predictable attendance in the performance of this job is an essential function.**

* Performs minor maintenance of trucks and equipment, such as greasing, washing and checking oil and tires.
* Responsible for street repairs and maintenance, including surface restoration, sign installation and repair, and painting traffic lines.
* Keeps public grounds clear and safe, including mowing grass, picking up debris and trash, and removing snow and ice during hazardous weather conditions.
* Maintains streets, storm drains, catch basins, parks and other public areas.
* Provides trash removal for City owned properties such as park spaces and recreation areas.
* Trims trees, removes brush and chips remaining wood.
* Maintains and cleans public restrooms, performs minor repairs on fixtures.
* Provides maintenance and repair of irrigation systems on sports fields and special plantings.
* Performs plowing, blowing and hauling of snow; sanding and salting of roadways
* Flushes and cleans manholes, catch basins, storm sewer, and storm sewer pipelines.
* Maintains ditches and natural water courses.
* Loads, hauls, and stockpiles sand, gravel, brush, and other materials.
* Maintains a safe work area by setting up barricades, warning devices, and proper vehicle/equipment placement.
* Maintains records of work performed.
* Performs tasks using hand tools, as required.
* Participates in “on-call” program and responds to emergency call outs.
* Performs building maintenance as assigned.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge Of**
**NECESSARY KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES**

* Or the ability to learn the geography and streets of the City and locations of public areas.
* Knowledge of safety laws and regulations and the occupational hazards and safety precautions necessary to the operation of heavy trucks and equipment.

**Skilled In**

* Safe work record and demonstration of a strong work ethic.
* Strong organizational skills and a willingness to be pro-active and accept new challenges.
* Building effective teams and providing efficient customer service.

**Ability To**

* Listen to, read, understand and communicate the English language so that others are able to understand. This must be done both orally and in writing, at the level appropriate for the position held.
* Understand and carry out oral and written instructions.
* Professionally handle public complaints and requests.
* Accept personal responsibility for one’s decisions.
* Maintain effective working relations with co-workers.
* Reliably and predictably carry out duties.

**SUPERVISION**
**Received:**
Works under the general supervision of the Department Foreman and the Public Works Director.
  
  
**Exercised:**
None.
  
  
**Job Qualifications**
**Required Education/Experience:**

* High School diploma or equivalent.
* Labor experience preferred.

**Other Requirements**

* Must possess a valid current state-issued driver’s license and not be under suspension, revocation or denial nor have any prior alcohol and/or drug related driving offenses within the last five years. A driving record search will be conducted on all applicants prior to employment and will be subject to observation throughout their employment.
* Must possess a Class “B” Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or obtain it within six (6) months of date of hire at the applicant’s expense.
* Successful candidates must pass a background investigation and physical examination in accordance with job duties prior to employment.
* Applicants will be required to undergo drug testing prior to employment and may be subject to further drug and alcohol testing throughout their employment as per City policy
* CPR/First Aid training required. All certifications, once achieved, must be maintained throughout employment.

**TOOLS & EQUIPMENT USED**
Must be able to operate equipment typical to the trade such as dump truck, pickup truck, utility truck, backhoe, snowplow, street sweeper, tamper, mowers, compressors, sanders, generators, common hand and power tools, shovels, wrenches, detection devices, mobile radio, phone.
  
  
**WORKING CONDITIONS**
*The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*
Tasks involve the ability to exert physical effort in moderate to intense work, typically involving some combination of stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, and which may involve some lifting, shoveling, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 100 pounds). The majority of a normal workday involves standing or walking.
  
  
Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discern colors or shades of colors. Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discern sounds or odors. Some tasks require depth perception or the ability to perceive and discern textures. Some tasks require visual perception and discrimination.
  
  
Tasks are regularly performed with exposure to adverse environmental conditions including, but not limited to, dirt, dust, pollen, odors, wetness, humidity, rain, fumes, temperature and noise extremes, machinery, vibrations, electric currents, traffic hazards, and toxic agents.
  
  
The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.

We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.

* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.

Be Linde. Be Limitless.
